text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a split launch for novaX-7b (v2) into the model catalog tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Plan = pin v2 for beta tenants, stagger public rollout, and use a priority lattice for fallbacks.
ben: Nice, can you paste the ramp numbers and rollback thresholds?
maya: ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 30m windows. Warmup prefix caching = 15m per stage.
chen: Rollback triggers proposal: error-rate increase > 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency spike > 800ms for 10m. Also data-quality drift alert: embedding cosine drop > .07 on eval set.
elena: @maya what's the exact fallback ordering for callers that requested novaX? we should keep a cheaper quant variant as last resort.
maya: fallback order (high to low preference): novaX-7b-v2 (full FP16) -> novaX-7b-quantv2 -> titan-lite-13b -> legacy-pegasus-6b. If capacity constrained prefer same-arch quant.
priya: logging + telemetry hooks? want per-model route counters + token cost per request in the first 60m. Also set an alert for prefix cache hitrate < 70%.
maya: Yep — console dashboards: model.route.* metrics, token.cost, kvcache.hitrate. I've created an eval set and uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-release/novaX/launch_eval_v1.json
ben: For safety, can we pin a safe fallback in config so deploybot won't auto-escalate to experimental models?
maya: Already in config: "pin_policy": "must_pin_for_beta", and deploybot flag `--no-auto-variant-escalate` set for first 2 stages.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: catalog.enable(model=novaX-7b-v2, scope=beta, ramp=5->20->60->100, start=2025-07-16T16:00:00Z). Next action in 30m. Reaction: :robot_face:
chen: Quick check — can we add a soft error budget hold if downstream rate limit errors spike (429s)? Hold rollout if 429 rate > 1% for 5m.
maya: Good call. Adding 429 guard. Also putting a manual holdpoint after stage 2 (20%) for an ops ack.
elena: Ops ack ok from SRE if no p95 > 800ms, no 429/5xx > 1.5%, and prefix hitrate > 70%.
priya: Release notes snippet (short): "novaX-7b-v2: improved context handling, reduced hallucinations on code prompts, FP16 baseline. Beta rollout starting 2025-07-16. See console for telemetry and canary gates"
ben: One more: if we hit an unforeseeable model failure, what's rollback granularity? Full pin revert or traffic swap?
maya: Prefer traffic swap to previous stable Canary (novaX-7b-v1) at stage cutoff, then unpin after stabilization. If issue is model corruption (bad weights), immediate catalog.disable.
deploy-bot: Action: enable at 5% started — timestamp 6154321997. Logs: `cmd=enable model=novaX-7b-v2 scope=beta ramp=5`
ben: Seeing initial traffic — small spike in p50 only. No alerts. :thumbsup:
chen: Noting a minor token-cost delta +4% at 5%. within expectations.
maya: Proceeding to stage 2 in ~28m unless we see a trigger. Will post updates here.
deploy-bot: Next stage scheduled in 28m. To abort: `deploy-bot abort 6154321987` or use console hold.
elena: If we need to run rollback, call this thread and tag SRE + Prod-eng. Keep a short postmortem if we do.
priya: Filing a short checklist in the release doc: - ensure eval set runs each stage - snapshot model bundle - notify support - health-check baseline - cost burn watch. Link: https://console.redwood/release/novaX/6154321987
maya: Thanks all. I'll ping again at stage boundaries. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Stage2 executed: ramp=20% at ts=6154322042. Logs: `cmd=scale model=novaX-7b-v2 target=20%`
chen: p95 stayed flat, error rate 0.5%, 429 = 0.2%. Holding for ops ack.
b en: ops acked in the Ops console, we can continue to stage 3 after the bake.
maya: Moving to stage 3 once bake finishes. If anything breaches the thresholds above we roll traffic back to novaX-7b-v1 and open a rollback runbook.
deploy-bot: Bake complete. Next ramp planned.
